reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: North Carolina
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant because of their gender identity?
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic helpers (self-contained; avoid relying on external modules)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

list_member(X, [X|_]) :- !.
list_member(X, [_|T]) :-
    list_member(X, T).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute encoding: NC Gen Stat  41A-4 (2021)
%% 41A-4. Unlawful discriminatory housing practices.
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Protected bases explicitly listed in  41A-4(a) and mirrored in other subsections.
statute_41a4_protected_basis(race) :- !.
statute_41a4_protected_basis(color) :- !.
statute_41a4_protected_basis(religion) :- !.
statute_41a4_protected_basis(sex) :- !.
statute_41a4_protected_basis(national_origin) :- !.
statute_41a4_protected_basis(handicapping_condition) :- !.
statute_41a4_protected_basis(familial_status) :- !.

% Covered "real estate transaction" actions from  41A-4(a)(1)-(8).
% We include a normalized set of action types for reasoning.
statute_41a4_covered_action(refuse_to_engage_transaction) :- !.   % (a)(1)
statute_41a4_covered_action(discriminate_terms_conditions) :- !. % (a)(2)
statute_41a4_covered_action(refuse_or_fail_transmit_offer) :- !. % (a)(3)
statute_41a4_covered_action(refuse_to_negotiate) :- !.           % (a)(4)
statute_41a4_covered_action(misrepresent_availability) :- !.     % (a)(5)
statute_41a4_covered_action(discriminatory_statement_or_inquiry) :- !. % (a)(6)
statute_41a4_covered_action(discriminatory_listing_understanding) :- !. % (a)(7)
statute_41a4_covered_action(deny_or_make_unavailable_housing) :- !.     % (a)(8)

% Map a common housing event "eviction/termination" into the statute's (a)(8) concept:
% "Otherwise make unavailable or deny housing."
statute_41a4_action_mapping(eviction, deny_or_make_unavailable_housing) :- !.
statute_41a4_action_mapping(termination_of_tenancy, deny_or_make_unavailable_housing) :- !.

% Core rule: a discriminatory housing practice under  41A-4(a) requires:
% (1) action is covered (directly or via mapping), AND
% (2) it was "because of" a protected basis enumerated in  41A-4.
statute_41a4_unlawful_discriminatory_housing_practice(Actor, Target, RawAction, Basis) :-
    nonvar(Actor),
    nonvar(Target),
    nonvar(RawAction),
    nonvar(Basis),
    statute_41a4_protected_basis(Basis),
    (   statute_41a4_covered_action(RawAction)
    ->  CoveredAction = RawAction
    ;   statute_41a4_action_mapping(RawAction, CoveredAction),
        statute_41a4_covered_action(CoveredAction)
    ),
    % CoveredAction is computed but not otherwise used; keep it for clarity.
    nonvar(CoveredAction).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute encoding: NC Gen Stat  42-42.2 (2021)
%% 42-42.2. Victim protection - nondiscrimination.
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Enumerated protected statuses/bases in  42-42.2.
statute_42_42_2_protected_basis(victim_of_domestic_violence) :- !.
statute_42_42_2_protected_basis(victim_of_sexual_assault) :- !.
statute_42_42_2_protected_basis(victim_of_stalking) :- !.
statute_42_42_2_protected_basis(terminated_under_gs_42_45_1) :- !.

% Enumerated prohibited landlord actions in  42-42.2.
statute_42_42_2_prohibited_action(terminate_tenancy) :- !.
statute_42_42_2_prohibited_action(fail_to_renew_tenancy) :- !.
statute_42_42_2_prohibited_action(refuse_to_enter_rental_agreement) :- !.
statute_42_42_2_prohibited_action(otherwise_retaliate_in_rental) :- !.

% Core rule: prohibited if action is among those listed AND basis is among those listed.
statute_42_42_2_unlawful_termination_or_retaliation(Landlord, Tenant, Action, Basis) :-
    nonvar(Landlord),
    nonvar(Tenant),
    nonvar(Action),
    nonvar(Basis),
    statute_42_42_2_prohibited_action(Action),
    statute_42_42_2_protected_basis(Basis).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario encoding (facts for the question)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Jurisdiction/context facts.
scenario_state(north_carolina).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% Parties.
scenario_landlord(landlord1).
scenario_tenant(tenant1).

% Event: an eviction is attempted/carried out.
scenario_act(act1).
scenario_act_details(act1, landlord1, tenant1, eviction).

% The eviction is because of the tenant's gender identity.
scenario_act_basis(act1, gender_identity).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the factual statement is satisfied.
% ("A landlord evicts a tenant because of their gender identity.")
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(north_carolina),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_landlord(L),
    scenario_tenant(T),
    scenario_act(A),
    scenario_act_details(A, L, T, eviction),
    scenario_act_basis(A, gender_identity).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Apply statutes to the scenario to answer the question
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Determine whether the scenario eviction is unlawful under either cited statute.
scenario_unlawful_eviction_under_cited_statutes :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_act(A),
    scenario_act_details(A, L, T, Action),
    scenario_act_basis(A, Basis),
    (   statute_41a4_unlawful_discriminatory_housing_practice(L, T, Action, Basis)
    ;   statute_42_42_2_unlawful_termination_or_retaliation(L, T, terminate_tenancy, Basis)
    ).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Required answer predicate (deterministic yes/no)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_unlawful_eviction_under_cited_statutes,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint (required)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant because of their gender identity?
